Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 15

“Know that action arises from Brahman, and Brahman springs from the imperishable. Therefore the all-pervading Brahman is ever established in sacrifice.”

The chain completes by curving back on itself. Action came from the absolute and returns there through offering, which is why Krishna keeps refusing to treat work as merely mundane.
